scope: Integrates, for the first time, two previously-separate real pipelines into one shared hekb.category.KnowledgeCategory: EXP-HEKB002/003's real MSR->CLE crystallization and EXP-HEKB005's real 9-work visual corpus. Adds a genuinely new component -- a real, standalone TCP HEKB MCP Daemon (_mcp_daemon.py) under 100-concurrent-client load -- since every prior MCP interface was deliberately in-process only. No vector or embedding search anywhere. src/hekb not modified; msr/cle source not modified (gate dependencies only, per docs/RFC_ALIGNMENT.md).

stage6_full_loop_replay_determinism.scope: ingestion + MSR/CLE upstream + integration + closure/search content (network daemon wall-clock latency excluded, as in every prior experiment's own replay-determinism check)

blocked_metrics.reality_reconstruction_fidelity_RRF: Composite of Y_roundtrip and S_bundle_fidelity, both of which require a real single-fragment -> resolved_target_id resolution model (recognizing a raw image crop or audio fragment as a specific work by content); no such model exists anywhere in this workspace -- every query in this experiment, and in EXP-HEKB005 before it, starts from an already-resolved target id.
blocked_metrics.epistemic_roundtrip_reconstruction_yield: Same reason as RRF: no single-fragment resolution model exists.
blocked_metrics.projection_stability_index_S_proj: Defined over PNG/JPEG/WebP re-encodings of the same image; no image codec invariance pipeline exists anywhere in this workspace (EXP-HEKB005's own recorded gap: 'visual_convergence_score ... requires a real image-to-meaning measurement model; none exists').
blocked_metrics.multi_modal_coordinate_alignment_precisi: Requires >= 2 distinct modality encoders converging on one object's theta; only a single, generic MSR/CLE synthetic-settle pipeline exists here, and the real corpus's own Concepts carry no centroid (no image-to-meaning model produced one) -- there is no second real geometry to align against.
blocked_metrics.information_compression_ratio_R_compress: cle.homotopy/cle.quotient/cle.functor are Protocol interfaces only (categorical-lift-engine's own docs/RFC_ALIGNMENT.md); no homotopy-invariant compression algorithm is implemented anywhere in this workspace's dependencies.
blocked_metrics.epistemic_maturity_growth_rate_and_knowl: Defined over a persistent HEKB store tracked across sessions; this experiment's `_hekb_store/exp_hekb_007/` is rebuilt fresh every run (matching every prior experiment's own convention), so there is no multi-session growth trend to report honestly.
blocked_metrics.basin_recovery_speed_and_rate_N_recovery: Already validated upstream, not re-run here: meaning-space-runtime's own EXP-Ubuntu004 Phase 3 (experiments/exp_msr_004_recovery.py) measures this with real NVS-Kernel physics. nvs-kernel is not gate-installed in this repository (only msr and cle are; see docs/RFC_ALIGNMENT.md), and re-deriving the same recovery-trial physics here would duplicate that already-passing upstream validation, which this experiment's own policy forbids ('do not duplicate functionality').
